episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: After a scandalous divorce, a tennis star, his ex-wife, and a volatile mix of guests converge on a coastal estate, where a troubled detective wrestles with his own despair.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: After an explosive night, a shocking murder is discovered at the estate, and Detective Leach must find his purpose again if he is to uproot the dark secrets of Gull's Point.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: When the killer strikes again, Detective Leach is drawn into a toxic maze of deceit and dysfunction and must rediscover his deepest copper's instincts if he is to find the truth.
